import Mathlib.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.ContinuousFunctionalCalculus.Basic

noncomputable section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
namespace NonCalkinAlgebra
universe u
variable {A : Type u} [CStarAlgebra A]

/-- The rational functional-calculus estimate needed to approximate x* by
elements of the two-sided ideal generated by x. -/
theorem exists_star_approximation (x : A) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ b : A, ‖star x - (star x * x) * b * star x‖ < δ := by
  let ε : ℝ := δ ^ 2
  have hε : 0 < ε := sq_pos_of_pos hδ
  let a : A := star x * x
  have ha : IsSelfAdjoint a := by dsimp [a]; exact .star_mul_self x
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => (t + ε)⁻¹
  let r : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => 1 - t * g t
  have hg : ContinuousOn g (spectrum ℝ a) := by
    apply (continuousOn_id.add continuousOn_const).inv₀
    intro t ht
    exact ne_of_gt (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (spectrum_star_mul_self_nonneg t ht) hε)
  have hr : ContinuousOn r (spectrum ℝ a) :=
    continuousOn_const.sub (continuousOn_id.mul hg)
  let b : A := cfc g a
  let c : A := 1 - a * b
  have hid : cfc (fun t : ℝ => t) a = a := by
    simpa only [id_eq] using cfc_id ℝ a ha
  have hc : cfc r a = c := by
    dsimp [r, c, b]
    rw [cfc_sub (fun _ : ℝ => 1) (fun t => t * g t) a continuousOn_const
      (continuousOn_id.mul hg), cfc_const_one ℝ a ha,
      cfc_mul (fun t : ℝ => t) g a continuousOn_id hg, hid]
  have hca : IsSelfAdjoint c := hc ▸ (IsSelfAdjoint.cfc (R := ℝ) (f := r) (a := a))
  have hmul : cfc (fun t : ℝ => r t * t * r t) a = c * a * c := by
    rw [cfc_mul (fun t : ℝ => r t * t) r a (hr.mul continuousOn_id) hr,
      cfc_mul r (fun t : ℝ => t) a hr continuousOn_id, hid, hc]
  have hpoint : ∀ t ∈ spectrum ℝ a, ‖r t * t * r t‖ ≤ ε / 4 := by
    intro t ht
    have ht₀ : 0 ≤ t := spectrum_star_mul_self_nonneg t ht
    have hden : 0 < t + ε := add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos ht₀ hε
    have heq : r t = ε / (t + ε) := by
      dsimp [r, g]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hden]
      <;> ring
    have hn : 0 ≤ r t * t * r t := by
      have he : r t * t * r t = (r t) ^ 2 * t := by ring
      rw [he]
      exact mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) ht₀
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hn, heq]
    have he : (ε / (t + ε)) * t * (ε / (t + ε)) = ε ^ 2 * t / (t + ε) ^ 2 := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hden]
      <;> ring
    rw [he]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hden)).2
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hε.le (sq_nonneg (t - ε))]
  have hnorm : ‖c * a * c‖ ≤ ε / 4 := by
    rw [← hmul]
    exact norm_cfc_le (by positivity) hpoint
  have hsq : ‖c * star x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ε / 4 := by
    calc
      ‖c * star x‖ ^ 2 = ‖(c * star x) * star (c * star x)‖ := by
        rw [CStarRing.norm_self_mul_star]
        ring
      _ = ‖c * a * c‖ := by
        congr 1
        rw [star_mul, star_star, hca.star_eq]
        simp only [a, mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ ε / 4 := hnorm
  have herror : star x - a * b * star x = c * star x := by
    dsimp [c]
    rw [sub_mul, one_mul]
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  change ‖star x - a * b * star x‖ < δ
  rw [herror]
  dsimp [ε] at hsq
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (c * star x)]

end NonCalkinAlgebra
